Create an elegant, minimalist architectural travel poster featuring [LANDMARK NAME], [CITY], [COUNTRY].

1. MAIN ARCHITECTURAL ILLUSTRATION

Feature the selected landmark as the central subject, illustrated entirely with delicate, continuous-looking hand-drawn outline strokes.

Preserve the landmark’s distinctive architectural silhouette and recognisable proportions.
Use clean, thin, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines.
Avoid solid fills, heavy shading and excessive details.
Make the architecture look like a beautiful architectural sketch.

2. COLOUR PALETTE

Use a sophisticated combination of 3–4 soft pastel colours for the outlines.

Choose colours that complement the destination’s identity, architecture and cultural character.

Examples:

Paris: Dusty rose, lavender, soft blue and muted coral.
London: Navy, muted red, sage and pale gold.
Tokyo: Vermilion, jade, blush pink and warm grey.
Italy: Terracotta, olive, dusty blue and ochre.
Greece: Aegean blue, turquoise, muted coral and lavender.

Every destination must have its own unique colour combination.

3. FLOATING TRAVEL DETAILS

Add a few delicate decorative elements around the landmark:

A small flying aeroplane with a dotted curved flight trail.
Tiny birds, clouds or stars.
Minimal geographical coordinates.
A small travel stamp or destination symbol.
Subtle architectural decorative details.

Keep everything light, delicate and uncluttered.

4. TYPOGRAPHIC ELEMENTS

Add the landmark’s name in elegant, refined typography.

Include:
[LANDMARK NAME]
[CITY, COUNTRY]

Place the destination name in a beautiful decorative ribbon banner near the bottom, leaving sufficient space for the illustration.

Use sophisticated serif or handwritten typography.

5. BACKGROUND & COMPOSITION

Use a beautiful warm ivory or soft cream background with subtle handmade-paper texture.

Maintain generous negative space around the central illustration.

Create a balanced composition with the landmark as the visual focus and small decorative elements positioned naturally around it.

6. ARTISTIC DIRECTION

Minimalist architectural line art, Scandinavian poster design, delicate pastel illustrations, elegant travel stationery, vintage sketchbook aesthetics and contemporary gallery-style graphic design.

7. FINAL FINISH

A timeless, sophisticated collectible travel poster that feels delicate, artistic and beautifully handcrafted.

Vertical 4:5 composition, crisp fine-line artwork, premium print quality, clean spacing and refined visual hierarchy.

Avoid photorealism, 3D effects, heavy colours, thick outlines, crowded compositions and unnecessary decorative elements.

东京：朱红、翡翠绿、腮红粉与暖灰。

Take 1 · the beanie on the fence

The prompts are exactly what I pasted. Swap the [brackets] in the image prompt for your own product and place.

Image (GPT Image 2.6 Flare):
Subject and action: a single chunky rib-knit wool beanie in [rust orange], with a folded cuff and a small cream woven label stitched on the front of the cuff that reads "SERRAFIO" in simple dark brown capital letters. SERRAFIO is a made-up brand. The beanie sits upright on top of a weathered wooden fence post, holding its shape.
Setting: a mountain pasture in [Serra da Mantiqueira] at early morning, a split-rail wooden fence running away from camera toward the beanie, tall araucaria pine trees soft in the background, low white mist in the valley behind, frost on the short grass.
Camera: low FPV perspective, 24mm wide lens, about 40 cm above the top fence rail, 2 meters from the beanie, looking along the rail straight at it.
Lighting: cool blue morning light with a warm 3500K sun just rising from camera left, rim light on the wool fibers, soft glow in the mist.
Composition: vertical 9:16, beanie centered in the middle third, fence rail leading toward it from the lower third, mist and araucaria silhouettes filling the upper third.
Materials and textures: thick ribbed wool with visible loose fibers, tight woven label edges, rough gray weathered wood with lichen, white frost crystals on grass.
Color grade and film look: rust orange against cool blue gray and pine green, cream label, rich blacks, cinematic film look, fine grain.
Mood: quiet cold morning, a warm handmade object waiting to be worn.
Realism details: a few wool fibers catching the sun, tiny frost on the fence rail, faint mist drifting between trees, label stitched slightly off straight.
Aspect ratio and settings: 9:16 vertical, photorealistic, the only text is the SERRAFIO label.
Avoid: any other logo or text, a second beanie, misspelled label, warped knit pattern, cartoon look, oversaturation, camera brand text.

Video (Gemini Omni Flash 1.1):
[Push in] Fast camera move from frame one: a low FPV shot glides forward along the top rail of the wooden fence straight at the rust orange SERRAFIO beanie on the fence post, covering most of the distance in the first two seconds, then eases into a close hero framing on the ribbed knit and the cream label.
Timing: 0 to 4 seconds, one continuous shot, full speed in frame one, no slow start.
Camera: 24mm wide feel, 40 cm above the rail, slight bank to the right, strong parallax as the fence rail and frosted grass slide past.
Subject: the beanie stays perfectly still on the post, same rib knit, same folded cuff, the label reads SERRAFIO the whole time.
Environment motion: low mist drifts slowly across the valley behind, araucaria branches sway a little, frost sparkles as the sun hits it, a few wool fibers move in the breeze.
Lighting: the camera moves from blue shade into the first warm sun and the wool glows orange on arrival.
Color grade: rust orange against cool blue gray and pine green, cream label, rich blacks, cinematic film look, fine grain.
Audio: quiet mountain wind, distant birds, no music, no voice.
Avoid: slow or static camera, gentle drift, morphing knit, changing or misspelled label letters, a second beanie, people, flicker, fade-in, cuts.

Why it works: the fence rail gives the camera a line to run along. The beanie never moves, so the knit has nothing to warp on the way in.

The catch: at 360p the label letters smeared until the camera got close. I rendered this take again at 720p and the label holds.

图像 (GPT Image 2.6 Flare)：
主体与动作：一顶厚实罗纹针织羊毛帽，颜色为 [铁锈橙]，带翻折帽口，帽口正面缝着一小块奶油色织唛，上面用简单的深棕色大写字母写着 "SERRAFIO"。SERRAFIO 是虚构品牌。这顶帽子直立放在一根风化的木栅栏柱顶端，形状保持不变。
环境：清晨的 [Serra da Mantiqueira] 山地牧场，一道劈木式栅栏从镜头方向延伸向帽子，背景是柔和的高大南洋杉（araucaria）松树，谷地后方有低垂的白雾，短草上覆着霜。
相机：低空 FPV 视角，24mm 广角镜头，大约在顶部栅栏横杆上方 40 厘米处，距离帽子 2 米，沿横杆方向直视帽子。
光线：冷蓝色晨光，镜头左侧刚升起的 3500K 暖阳，羊毛纤维上有轮廓光，雾气中泛着柔和的辉光。
构图：竖幅 9:16，帽子居中位于画面中三分之一，栅栏横杆从下三分之一引导向帽子，雾气与南洋杉剪影填满上三分之一。
材质与纹理：厚重罗纹羊毛，可见松散纤维，织唛边缘紧密整齐，粗糙的灰色风化木头上有地衣，草上有白色霜晶。
调色与胶片质感：铁锈橙对比冷调蓝灰与松绿色，奶油色织唛，浓郁暗部，电影胶片质感，细腻颗粒。
氛围：安静寒冷的清晨，一件温暖的手工物件等待着被戴上。
真实感细节：几缕羊毛纤维捕捉到阳光，栅栏横杆上有细小霜痕，树间薄雾缓缓飘动，织唛的缝线略微歪斜。
画幅与设置：9:16 竖幅，照片写实，唯一的文字是 SERRAFIO 织唛。
避免：任何其他标识或文字，第二顶帽子，织唛拼写错误，针织纹理扭曲，卡通风格，过饱和，相机品牌文字。

视频 (Gemini Omni Flash 1.1)：
[推近] 从第一帧开始的快速运镜：一个低空 FPV 镜头沿木栅栏顶部的横杆向前滑行，直冲铁锈橙色的 SERRAFIO 毛线帽（在栅栏柱上），在前两秒内完成大部分距离，随后缓缓转为罗纹针织与奶油色织唛的特写英雄机位。
时长：0 至 4 秒，一个连续镜头，第一帧即全速开始，没有慢启动。
相机：24mm 广角感，高出横杆 40 厘米，向右略微倾斜，栅栏横杆和结霜的草地快速滑过，产生强烈视差。
主体：帽子在柱子上完全静止，相同的罗纹针织，相同的翻折帽口，织唛全程显示 SERRAFIO。
环境动态：低处薄雾在身后谷地上缓缓飘移，南洋杉枝条轻微摇动，霜在阳光照射下闪光，几缕羊毛纤维在微风中摆动。
光线：相机从蓝色阴影中移动到第一缕暖阳中，抵达时羊毛泛出橙色光晕。
调色：铁锈橙对比冷调蓝灰与松绿色，奶油色织唛，浓郁暗部，电影胶片质感，细腻颗粒。
音频：安静的山风，远处鸟鸣，无音乐，无人声。
避免：缓慢或静止的相机，轻柔漂移，针织形态变化，织唛字母变化或拼写错误，第二顶帽子，人物，闪烁，淡入，切镜头。

为什么有效：栅栏横杆给了相机一条可以沿着走的引导线。帽子始终不动，所以推进过程中针织纹理没有可扭曲之处。

需要注意的问题：在 360p 下，织唛字母在相机靠近之前一直是糊的。我用 720p 重新渲染了这条，织唛就清晰了。
